response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId AS raceId, p.avg_points AS avg_points, p.avg_wins AS avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS wins_diff FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wins_diff IS NULL, wins_diff DESC LIMIT 10;
